judge_input.description:
see the commits down below here. Basically what I am doing is that I'm going ahead and reworking things so as to drop the cruft out of our fedora-coreos-config, and the situation over there is that there happens to be an awful lot of duplication sitting around in it. The reason that all of that duplication is there in the first place is because of the fact that we have been going along supporting both of two different things at once: on the one hand there is the old style `cosa build`, and then on the other hand there is the new build via container way of doing it, which is to say the `cosa build-with-buildah` builds.

commit 22bb4c2a1c02d3d59ad8a840b31bb376a3271d3f
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 16:35:36 2025 -0500

    add python3-dotenv to deps
    
    The thing that we want to do here is to make use of this particular
    library, and the purpose that we want to use it for is to parse the
    build-args.conf file, which is a file that is really nothing more than
    just environment variables sitting there in var=val format.

commit bc55ead4be4160c0afd7c1231a4b8d891c50f5dc
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 16:32:34 2025 -0500

    move some manifest parsed env vars to cmd-build
    
    These particular ones here are only ever used over in cmd-build and
    nowhere else at all, so what we may as well do is go ahead and move
    them over there where they belong, and the reason for doing that is so
    as to make it a good deal more explicit where it is that they are
    actually being used.

commit ef1b4fbbbd1882aaf6f8b8d0a6bbe059914cfbd1
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 15:19:07 2025 -0500

    cmdlib: drop requirement for automatic-version-prefix in the manifest
    
    The direction we're heading in is that we're moving ourselves away from
    most of the rpm-ostree high level features, and this particular one
    right here happens to be one of those very features, and it is one that
    we no longer really have any need for anymore at all, at least not in
    the build-via-container world that we now find ourselves in.

commit e90ae1900ae78548d3bcb64347a6e40123120f6a
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 14:47:22 2025 -0500

    cmd-build-with-buildah: trim log statement
    
    The way I feel about it is that I find the `...` sitting there on the
    end of this statement annoying to have around. What it does is that it
    makes the whole thing harder to copy/paste the version out of, at least
    in the case where I happened to want to go and do that, and then on top
    of that it also makes it harder for my human brain to go and process it
    as well into the bargain.

@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@ Usage: coreos-assembler build --help

 prepare_build
 
+# Use metadata.name as the name of the VM images
